metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the dinner, the phrase, and an afternoon in the Shrew.

yesterday: Ralph Raye paid twelve pence on his own debt. He saw the page. Yesterday's play, Long Meg, is set against the thirtieth.
The sums were right to the farthing. A man may lose a day. Nobody loses a shilling by mistake.
The company's word for never is on the thirty-first of April. Kemp's sixpence was an offer. You did not pay it. No sum of the other house was spoken.
You were in the Shrew. You did not name the part. The king's page stayed upstairs.
Tomorrow is May Day. The book of the comedy stays with the house through the afternoon.
